verses.en: Sha'ul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the assembly of the Thessalonians in YAHUAH our Father and the Master Yahushua the Messiah:
verses.am: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.en: Grace unto you, and peace, from YAHUAH our Father and the Master Yahushua the Messiah.
verses.am: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: We are bound to thank YAHUAH always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
verses.am: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

verses.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the assemblies of YAHUAH for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
verses.am: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

verses.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of YAHUAH, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of YAHUAH, for which ye also suffer:
verses.am: {Which is} a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

verses.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with YAHUAH to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
verses.am: Seeing {it is} a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

verses.en: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Master Yahushua shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.am: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, {his...: Gr. the angels of his power}

verses.en: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not YAHUAH, and that obey not the gospel of our Master Yahushua the Messiah:
verses.am: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ: {taking: or, yielding}

verses.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Master, and from the glory of his power;
verses.am: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

verses.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.am: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

verses.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our YAHUAH would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
verses.am: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of {this} calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of {his} goodness, and the work of faith with power: {count: or, vouchsafe}

verses.en: That the name of our Master Yahushua the Messiah may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our YAHUAH and the Master Yahushua the Messiah.
verses.am: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Master Yahushua the Messiah, and by our gathering together unto him,
verses.am: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and {by} our gathering together unto him, {unto him: or, around him}

verses.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Messiah is at hand.
verses.am: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

verses.en: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.am: Let no man deceive you by any means: for {that day shall not come}, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

verses.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called YAHUAH, or that is worshipped; so that he as YAHUAH sitteth in the temple of YAHUAH, shewing himself that he is YAHUAH.
verses.am: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

verses.en: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.am: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

verses.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.am: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time. {withholdeth: or, holdeth}

verses.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.am: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth {will let}, until he be taken out of the way.

verses.en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Master shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.am: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

verses.en: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.am: {Even him}, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.am: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

verses.en: And for this cause YAHUAH shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.am: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

verses.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.am: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to YAHUAH for you, brethren beloved of the Master, because YAHUAH hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.am: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

verses.en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Master Yahushua the Messiah.
verses.am: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.am: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

verses.en: Now our Master Yahushua the Messiah himself, and YAHUAH, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.am: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given {us} everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

verses.en: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.am: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

verses.en: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Master may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
verses.am: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have {free} course, and be glorified, even as {it is} with you: {have...: Gr. run}

verses.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
verses.am: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all {men} have not faith. {unreasonable: Gr. absurd}

verses.en: But the Master is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.am: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep {you} from evil.

verses.en: And we have confidence in the Master touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.am: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

verses.en: And the Master direct your hearts into the love of YAHUAH, and into the patient waiting for Messiah.
verses.am: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ. {patient...: or, patience of Christ}

verses.en: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Master Yahushua the Messiah, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.am: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

verses.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.am: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

verses.en: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.am: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

verses.en: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.am: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

verses.en: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.am: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

verses.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.am: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

verses.en: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Master Yahushua the Messiah, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.am: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

verses.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.am: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing. {be...: or, faint not}

verses.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.am: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed. {by...: or, signify that man by an epistle}

verses.en: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.am: Yet count {him} not as an enemy, but admonish {him} as a brother.

verses.en: Now the Master of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Master be with you all.
verses.am: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord {be} with you all.

verses.en: The salutation of Sha'ul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.am: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

verses.en: The grace of our Master Yahushua the Messiah be with you all. Amen. «The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.»
verses.am: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen. «{The second epistle} to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.»
